verdict.rationale: Next.js is a React web framework. It has no in-product UI that holds a user's business data, so AI-generated insights over that data is a category error for this kind of product. The built-in MCP endpoint (next-js-docs-17) only gives coding agents access to a running app. It is a different capability and does not make this axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
